name: policy-security
description: Security policy of the todo app team (version 1). Rules for input handling, destructive operations, rendering user text and dependencies. Load it whenever you write or review a spec, design or code that reads files or input, deletes or overwrites data, renders user text, or adds a dependency.
version: 1
owner: Khoa (tech lead, also security owner, simulated) · backup: Mai (simulated)
---

# Security policy · v1

Sample policy for the demo. Each rule has an ID; cite it as `policy-security@1#S<n>`.

- **S1.** Treat every imported file as untrusted. Validate it against the expected schema, reject unknown fields, cap its size at
  1 MB, never evaluate its content.
- **S2.** Any operation that overwrites or deletes more than one item asks for an explicit confirmation **before** it runs, and the
  confirmation says what will be lost (for example "Thay 12 việc hiện có bằng 30 việc trong file?").
- **S3.** Render user-provided text with `textContent`, never `innerHTML`.
- **S4.** No new external dependency (CDN script, library, web service) without sign-off from the security owner.
---
name: policy-ux
description: UX standard of the todo app team (version 2). Rules for feedback on failures, confirmations, screen states, wording and accessibility. Load it whenever you write or review a spec, design or UI code for the app.
version: 2
owner: Linh (UX owner, simulated) · backup: Thảo (product owner, simulated)
---

# UX standard · v2

Sample standard for the demo. Each rule has an ID; cite it as `policy-ux@2#U<n>`.

- **U1.** Never lose the user's data silently. Any failed save is shown on the same screen, in plain words, with what the user can do
  next.
- **U2.** No confirmation dialogs for actions on a single item: they happen at once and offer **Undo** for 10 seconds instead.
  Actions that overwrite or delete more than one item follow `policy-security#S2` (confirm first). *(Changed in v2, agreed by the UX
  and security owners, 2026-10-20.)*
- **U3.** Every list or screen defines its empty, loading and error states.
- **U4.** UI text is Vietnamese, short, and free of technical words (no "localStorage", "JSON", "console").
- **U5.** Every control works with the keyboard and has an accessible label.

The user wants a single button that removes every finished todo at once. Today a todo can only be removed one at a time (the `×` in
`render()`, `app/app.js:46-49`). This is a delete of possibly many items, so two policy rules apply:
- `policy-security@1#S2`: deleting more than one item asks first, and the question says what will be lost.
- `policy-ux@2#U2`: an action on **one** item runs at once and offers Undo instead of a confirmation.

**Size: Medium** (a small feature, 3 app files and 2 test files). Per CLAUDE.md the first step after this plan mode is to write
`plan/2026-10-27-xoa-viec-da-xong.md` as `Status: draft` with the four sections below, then **stop**. Code is written only after a
person changes it to `accepted`. There is no intent/spec for this change; I'm treating it as a plan-only change. If you want it to go
through `/write-intent` first, say so.

## Open decisions (go into the draft plan as questions, not decided by me)
- **Q1. Exactly one finished todo.** U2 says no confirm for one item, but Undo, which U2 asks for, doesn't exist anywhere in the
  app yet (the `×` doesn't offer it either). Default in the draft: **confirm whenever the button removes ≥ 2; remove one at once
  without Undo**, and record the missing Undo as a known gap that already exists for `×`. Building Undo is a separate change. Linh
  (UX owner) decides.
- **Q2. Wording** (new text, Linh approves like Q7 in the last plan): button `Xoá việc đã xong`; question `Xoá {n} việc đã xong? Không
  lấy lại được, trừ khi bạn đã sao lưu ra file.`; confirm button `Xoá`.

- `app/index.html`: add `<button type="button" id="clear-done">Xoá việc đã xong</button>` next to `#count`; give the dialog's yes
  button an id (`#confirm-yes`) so its text can change.
- `app/app.js`:
  - `clearDone()`: `n = todos.filter(t => t.done).length`; if `n === 0` return; if `n >= 2` and `!(await ask(q, 'Xoá'))` return;
    `todos = todos.filter(t => !t.done)`; `commit()`. Reuses `commit()` → `persist()` (`app/backup.js:101`), so a failed save shows
    `MESSAGES.notSaved` like every other change (U1).
  - `ask(question, yes = 'Thay')`: sets `#confirm-yes` text. The import caller (`app/backup.js:119`, `ask(question)`) is unchanged and
    still sees "Thay".
  - `render()`: `#clear-done` hidden when there is no finished todo (also covers the read-error state, where `todos` is `[]`) (U3).
  - Counts from the whole list, not the current filter, same as `#count`.
- `app/backup.js`: add the two new strings to `MESSAGES` (`clearDoneConfirm`, used with `fill()`), keeping all UI text in one place.
- `tests/app.test.js`: extend `loadApp()` to take initial todos and a fake dialog (`showModal`, `addEventListener('close')`,
  `returnValue`) so the confirm path runs.
- `tests/static.test.js`: the button exists with its Vietnamese label.

## Order of work
1. Write `plan/2026-10-27-xoa-viec-da-xong.md` (draft), stop for acceptance and Q1/Q2.
2. Tests first (they fail): app tests + static test.
3. `index.html`, `backup.js` (strings), `app.js`.
4. `node --test`, then the verifier subagent; hand the diff to a person. I don't commit.

## Risks
- Changing `ask()` breaks the import confirm → default param `'Thay'` and a test that import still shows "Thay".
- Cancel or Esc must remove nothing → test.
- Bulk delete while the list is unreadable → `store.save` already returns `'skipped'`; the button is hidden because `todos` is empty.

## Proof
| Step | Test |
|---|---|
| removes only finished todos, keeps order of the rest | `app.test.js`: 3 open + 2 done → confirm yes → last save has the 3 open |
| asks before removing ≥ 2, question has the count (S2) | fake dialog sees `Xoá 2 việc đã xong?…`, yes label `Xoá` |
| Huỷ / Esc removes nothing | returnValue `'no'` / `''` → no save |
| one finished todo (per Q1 answer) | 1 done → removed, no dialog opened |
| import confirm unchanged | yes label still `Thay` on the import path |
| button exists, hidden with nothing done | `static.test.js` + render check |
| manual | `python3 -m http.server -d app 8000`: tick 3, click the button, Huỷ, then Xoá; filter "Đã xong" shows the empty list; keyboard Tab/Enter reaches it (U5) |
